meta.note: naive = textbook asymptotic two-sample KS (SciPy kstwo), Bonferroni over 7 features, persist 3, cooldown 1800 s (max 48 alarms/day); calibrated = empirical leave-one-train-day-out null at quantile q (q = 0.999 is the committed ksc_refit); off = alpha 0 (never fires).

separation.text: exact probability under exchangeability that a window of m points lies entirely outside a reference of n points (D = 1): 2 / C(m+n, m)
